thread:
incident-bot: PAGING oncall: p99 latency alert (cont-batch path) for service=redwood-inference-gen, region=us-west2. Spike detected at 2026-03-15T09:12:14Z. p99--> 2.8s (baseline 0.4s). :rotating_light:
Anya K: saw it too, hit from streaming clients. dashboards show streaming stalls + queue length growing on cont-batch scheduler.
Lee C: confirmed. total qlen ~420, avg batch size spiked to 48 on a node pool that's tuned to 32. p95 up to 1.2s, p99 2.8s.
Maria P: any customer-facing errors? I see a small uptick in stream disconnects (0.6% -> 1.9%).
Sam R: customers with long-form generation will feel it. Looks correlated with mixed-seq workload from a new client job that started ~09:08.
Jon T: linking logs: ```[2026-03-15T09:09:01Z] scheduler: accepted 120 reqs; avg_seq_len=780; median=120; bimodal distribution. kv_cache pressure rising, eviction rate jump.```
Anya K: this is classic mixed-length amplification on cont-batch path. Long seqs inflate batch padding and delay small-seq requests -> head-of-line.
Lee C: immediate mitigation options: 1) disable continuous batching on affected pool 2) reduce max_batch_size to 24 3) enable seqlen-weighted scheduling (fast path) 4) route streaming traffic to dedicated smaller-batch pool.
Maria P: what's cheapest low-risk step?
Sam R: disable cont-batch briefly on that pool. It will increase GPU idle but should cut tail. Can we flip via runtime flag?
eng-runtime: yes, we have `runtime.flags.continuous_batching=false` per-pool. Rolling change via `/infra/ops toggle` should be fine.
Jon T: I'll run a targeted flag flip on pool usw2-contbatch-3. Command: ```infractl runtime set-flag --pool=usw2-contbatch-3 --flag=continuous_batching --value=false --reason="p99 tail mitigation"```
Anya K: also propose reducing max_batch_size on pool to 24 to avoid huge pads when we re-enable.
Lee C: queueing policy change: enable `seqlen_weighted=true` to prefer packing similar lengths. That needs a restart of batcher process (low risk 1 pod rolling).
Maria P: agree to both. Can we do the flag flip now and follow with max_batch change?
Sam R: I'll coordinate. Running flag change now.
ops-bot: infractl job queued [job-id=infra-4300001].
ops-bot: job infra-4300001: success. `cont-batch` disabled on pool=usw2-contbatch-3.
Lee C: telemetry: p99 dropped to 0.9s within ~45s. p95 back to ~0.35s. Queue length dropping.
Anya K: great. Follow-up: reduce `max_batch_size` to 24 and enable `seqlen_weighted` on same pool. Sam, Jon take it.
Sam R: applying max_batch_size change: ```infractl runtime set-config --pool=usw2-contbatch-3 --key=max_batch_size --value=24```
ops-bot: config change applied.
Sam R: enabling seqlen_weighted scheduling (rolling restart 3 pods). Triggering now.
deploy-bot: Rolling restart initiated: batcher-usw2-3 (3 pods). watch /deploys/batcher-usw2-3
Jon T: restart finished. Metrics show smaller batch variance, avg batch now ~18, padding overhead down ~45%. p99 holding ~0.6s.
Maria P: customer impact summary: small subset of streaming traffic saw elevated latency and disconnects between 09:08-09:13. Affected customers: 2 high-traffic streaming tenants (tenant-42, tenant-86). We need to notify account teams.
Anya K: opening incident ticket and P0 triage doc. Assigning to Eng Runtime for root cause tracking (likely scheduling + mixed sequence lengths interacting with cont-batch heuristics).
Sam R: incident ticket created: INC-20260315-00432. Includes runbook steps taken and timeline.
Jon T: next steps for RC: 1) add adaptive seqlen heuristics to batcher to detect bimodal seq distributions and split packs 2) implement packing timeout cap to avoid long waits caused by large seqs 3) improve KV cache eviction scoring to prefer evicting cold keys 4) create alert that tracks avg_batch_padding_pct > 30% on cont-batch pools.
Lee C: also consider per-tenant backpressure for extremely long sessions (apply rate-limits).
Maria P: customer comms: I'll draft a short note for accounts and classify as "partial degradation" for 5 minutes.
Anya K: handoff plan: I'm going offline in 30m, Sam will be primary follow-up, Jon for runtime changes, Lee for on-call monitoring.
Sam R: taking handoff. Will keep watch for 1hr, run additional mitigations if p99 creeps >0.8s.
incident-bot: Reminder: create postmortem within 72h. Severity: Sev-2.
Anya K: assigning to eng-runtime team, tagging @eng-runtime for visibility.
eng-runtime: acknowledged. We'll start RC and propose a patch to batcher heuristics tomorrow.
Maria P: thanks everyone. I'll notify account owners and update incident ticket with customer messaging draft. :white_check_mark:
Jon T: saving logs/snippets to incident ticket. ```grep -A5 -B3 "avg_seq_len" /var/logs/batcher/usw2/2026-03-15.log | tail -n 40```
Sam R: leaving a follow-up TODO: add a canary test against mixedlength synthetic workload to detect packing amplification before rolling changes.
Lee C: noting runbook tweak: include immediate flag to throttle long-seq job ingestion.
Maria P: last check: p99 stabilized at 0.58s for 10m. closing oncall handover in thread.
Anya K: thanks all — handing off to Sam for watch.
Sam R: got it. I'll post an update if anything changes. :eyes:
